desc: Kingfisher spirit: floating teal-lavender hooded cloak with orange belly patch, long gold beak jutting from the hood, two small fins like wings. Mythical hooded spirit like a floating hooded fox spirit: big round head under a hood, tiny body, round black void face with two small white dot eyes, cute and cool, right-facing 3/4, full body. 16-bit pixel art, 1px navy outline, 2-3 flat shades, no gradients, no noise. No halo, no sparkles, no shadow.
